assumptions.statement: The site and three key-area geometries are repository-maintained rough polygons derived for intake; they are not official redlines.
assumptions.impact: All spatial ratios, areas, positions and drawings are provisional and must be recalculated when official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Approved regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, utilities, heritage protection, fire and engineering conditions are not included.
assumptions.impact: Building scale, FAR, height, density, setback, road and municipal statements remain conceptual suggestions.

assumptions.statement: The package uses the official announcement, the cleared agent taskbook, repository source registry and derived geometry; no private maps, personal data or unlicensed media are used.
assumptions.impact: External case comparisons are background prompts, not formal site facts.

assumptions.statement: Public receipts, AI scenario cards, annual events and community roles are proposed operating patterns, not confirmed public-sector commitments.
assumptions.impact: Professional, legal, accessibility, privacy and operations teams must confirm governance before any pilot.
